Shows the slots of a bookable product (its Booking schedule, set in the Shopify admin) for days days, the places left of each, the day in the site's language and the time in the place's time zone; picking a free slot books it as its container says. In a booking-form: the form books it. In a product's add to cart: adding the product holds the slot for the quantity and writes it on the product's lines (a paid appointment); no slot or a full one stops the addition with the message. In the cart: the slot is held when picked and written on the cart (a pickup or delivery window); a slot taken by someone else meanwhile is refused at checkout, and with data-required the checkout stops until a slot is picked. The places are counted by Smootify: two visitors cannot book the last one. The availability is kept a minute, so pages opened again ask nothing.

outsideContext.detail: also on a site whose licence has no "Booking"; logs an error without a [booking="day"] template

Webflow's success and error states show the answer; a slot that filled up meanwhile is the form error and the calendar shows its places again.

tags.purpose: Creates a metaobject from a Webflow form: every filled field whose name does not start with _; a name the form repeats (a checkbox group with each checkbox's value, a multiple select) sends all its values; a lone checkbox sends true / false. The backend converts each value to its field type: rating from a number (the field's scale), list.* from repeated values, a comma separated text or a JSON array, boolean, number_decimal with a comma, url without https://, references from a numeric id, rich_text_field from lines (one paragraph each), money in the shop currency, date_time from datetime-local, dimension / volume / weight from "2.5 cm" (a select data-unit-for="<name>" gives the unit of that field, its own name is not sent); a value already in Shopify's format passes as it is. A definition without the publishable capability gets no status (data-draft is ignored there). The backend refuses Shopify's standard types (shopify--…), the app-reserved ones ($app:…) and Smootify's own (magic_box, combinations, dynamic_property, option), with the form error "This form cannot create entries of this metaobject type". customer-field="<key>": the entry belongs to the logged-in customer, written by the backend into that field (a customer reference) from the Customer Account token, never from the form; logged out the element is hidden and its form inert (is-customer while logged in), and a request without a valid token is refused ("Log in to send this form").

passwordless-login.does: reads no field: the submit starts the Customer Accounts login

customer-subscribe-email.does: reads no field: the submit subscribes or unsubscribes the logged-in customer

customer-unsubscribe-email.does: reads no field: the submit subscribes or unsubscribes the logged-in customer

customer-user-update.name: `firstName`, `lastName`
customer-user-update.does: the customer's first and last name, prefilled when the customer has one and the field is not focused

customer-user-update.name: any other name
customer-user-update.does: not sent: only the first and last name go to Shopify

create-address.name: `countryCode`
create-address.does: the country, made required (1.x and the first 2.0 builds: `territoryCode`, which Shopify deprecated; the debugger flags it); Smootify fills the options with the countries the shop ships to, keeping an option without a value as the placeholder

create-address.name: `zoneCode`
create-address.does: the province or state; Smootify replaces every option with the zones of the chosen country, the select is required only when the country has zones, and the host has `no-zone` until it does

create-address.name: `firstName`, `lastName`, `company`, `address1`, `address2`, `city`, `zip`
create-address.does: the address lines; in `edit-address` every field named like a key of the address is prefilled

create-address.name: `defaultAddress`
create-address.does: checked: the address becomes the default; unchecked: the default stays

create-address.name: any other name
create-address.does: sent to Shopify, which refuses the address: leave it out

edit-address.name: `countryCode`
edit-address.does: the country, made required (1.x and the first 2.0 builds: `territoryCode`, which Shopify deprecated; the debugger flags it); Smootify fills the options with the countries the shop ships to, keeping an option without a value as the placeholder

edit-address.name: `zoneCode`
edit-address.does: the province or state; Smootify replaces every option with the zones of the chosen country, the select is required only when the country has zones, and the host has `no-zone` until it does

edit-address.name: `firstName`, `lastName`, `company`, `address1`, `address2`, `city`, `zip`
edit-address.does: the address lines; in `edit-address` every field named like a key of the address is prefilled

edit-address.name: `defaultAddress`
edit-address.does: checked: the address becomes the default; unchecked: the default stays

edit-address.name: any other name
edit-address.does: sent to Shopify, which refuses the address: leave it out

delete-address.name: `id`
delete-address.does: the address deleted; the form of the default address is removed

subscription-activate.does: reads no field: the contract comes from the wrapper's `data-contract-id`

subscription-pause.does: reads no field: the contract comes from the wrapper's `data-contract-id`

subscription-cancel.does: reads no field: the contract comes from the wrapper's `data-contract-id`

logout-form.does: reads no field: the submit logs out and follows Shopify's logout url

webflow-form.does: reads no field: the submit shows the success state and follows `data-redirect`

customer-metafields-editor.name: any name: the metafield key
customer-metafields-editor.does: saves the customer metafield `custom.<key>`, the key being the snake_case of `data-name` (the `name` as written without it), and is prefilled from it, select and textarea included; a lone checkbox saves `true` checked and `false` unchecked; names starting with `_` and empty values are not saved, and a repeated name keeps its last value

metaobject-creator.name: any name: the field key
metaobject-creator.does: the metaobject field whose key is the snake_case of `data-name` ("Serial number" → `serial_number`, as `customer-metafields-editor`), else the `name`; names starting with `_` and empty values are not sent; a repeated name sends a list, a lone checkbox `true` / `false`, a `[data-unit-for]` field adds its unit to that field and is not sent itself, a `file-input[data-multiple]` a list of file gids

newsletter-subscribe.name: the first `input[type="email"]` (any name)
newsletter-subscribe.does: renamed `email`: the address subscribed; every other field is ignored

klaviyo-back-in-stock.name: `email` (any case), else the first `input[type="email"]`
klaviyo-back-in-stock.does: the address Klaviyo alerts (Webflow's default Email field works: `data-name="Email"`); every other field is ignored

smootify-add-to-cart.requiredNote: the scope quantity without the field

smootify-add-to-cart.name: `sellingPlanId`
smootify-add-to-cart.requiredNote: the scope's plan without the field
smootify-add-to-cart.does: the selling plan of the line

smootify-add-to-cart.name: `option1`, `option2`, `option3`
smootify-add-to-cart.does: a bare `select[name="optionN"]` picks that option; never a line property

smootify-add-to-cart.name: `Recipient email`
smootify-add-to-cart.does: gift card: Shopify sends the card to this address

smootify-add-to-cart.name: `Send on`
smootify-add-to-cart.does: gift card: the day the card is sent (Smootify sets today as the minimum)

smootify-add-to-cart.name: `buy-now` (submit button)
smootify-add-to-cart.does: the line goes straight to checkout

smootify-add-to-cart.name: any Name on a field of an add-on widget (`addon-checkbox`, `addon-select`, `addon-dropdown`, `addon-popover`, `addon-swatches`, the add-on's `quantity-input`)
smootify-add-to-cart.does: never a property of the main line, whatever the Name (Webflow needs one). From mount the widget names its fields `##ignore-addon`, left out of the line; once the add-on's product loads they get the names of the add-on line (2.0)

smootify-add-to-cart.name: any other name, or `properties[Name]`
smootify-add-to-cart.does: a line item property named as the field's `data-name`; a checkbox with `data-name` sends its `data-value`, else `✓`; a file is sent as JSON; empty values are not sent; a name starting with `_` is hidden at checkout and in the cart

name-your-price.name: the first `input[type="number"]` (any name)
name-your-price.does: the unit price, bounded by its `min` / `max`; never a line property

configurator-input.name: the `data-name`, else the `name`, of the first named element
configurator-input.does: the step name the formulas use

configurator-checkbox.name: the `data-name`, else the `name`, of the first named element
configurator-checkbox.does: the step name the formulas use

configurator-radio.name: the `data-name`, else the `name`, of the first named element
configurator-radio.does: the step name the formulas use

configurator-select.name: the `data-name`, else the `name`, of the first named element
configurator-select.does: the step name the formulas use

configurator-dropdown.name: the `data-name`, else the `name`, of the first named element
configurator-dropdown.does: the step name the formulas use

configurator-popover.name: the `data-name`, else the `name`, of the first named element
configurator-popover.does: the step name the formulas use

configurator-dimension.name: each `input[type="number"]` (its `name`)
configurator-dimension.does: the formula variable of that value; the other inputs are removed

file-input.name: the element's `name`, else its `input[type="file"]`'s
file-input.does: the field the uploaded files are sent under; the file input itself loses its name

file-uploader.name: the element's `name`, else its `input[type="file"]`'s
file-uploader.does: the field the uploaded files are sent under; the file input itself loses its name

configurator-file-input.name: the element's `name`, else its `input[type="file"]`'s
configurator-file-input.does: the field the uploaded files are sent under; the file input itself loses its name

booking-form.name: `name`, `email`, `phone`, `note` (any case: Webflow's `Name`, `Email` work)
booking-form.does: written on the Booking entry the submit creates in the store, trimmed; an empty value is not sent

booking-form.name: any other name
booking-form.does: not sent: only these four reach the store
the slot is the one picked in its `booking-calendar` ("Choose a slot" without one); a logged-in visitor's customer is added to the entry by Smootify, no field needed

smootify-magic-box-cart.name: `buy-now` (submit button)
smootify-magic-box-cart.does: the box goes straight to checkout (also `data-buy-now`)

smootify-magic-box-cart.name: any name
smootify-magic-box-cart.does: a property of the box's first line, named as the field's `data-name`; empty values are not sent

smootify-consent.name: `analytics`, `marketing`, `preferences`, `sale_of_data` (or `saleOfData`)
smootify-consent.requiredNote: a missing `analytics`, `marketing` or `preferences` counts as declined
smootify-consent.does: checked: that kind of tracking is allowed, saved by `[data-action="save"]`; the boxes follow the stored consent, Webflow's custom checkbox included

smootify-cart.name: `note`
smootify-cart.does: the order note, saved before checkout and prefilled; a field whose name is `Note` becomes `note` (1.x read only a textarea)

smootify-cart.name: `coupon`
smootify-cart.does: a discount code, applied by `button[data-action="coupon"]` or Enter, cleared after; a field whose name is `Coupon` becomes `coupon`

smootify-cart.name: `gift-card` (or `Gift Card`)
smootify-cart.does: a gift card code, applied by `button[data-action="gift-card"]` (Enter only with `gift-card`)

smootify-cart.name: `email`
smootify-cart.does: with a quote (`draft-order`): the email of the draft order (the logged-in customer otherwise); without a quote a cart attribute

smootify-cart.name: `quantity`
smootify-cart.does: inside a cart line: that line's quantity

smootify-cart.name: `draft-order` (submit button)
smootify-cart.does: sends the cart as a quote (draft order) instead of the checkout

smootify-cart.name: any other name
smootify-cart.does: a cart attribute named as the field's `data-name`, saved before checkout; refilled for text, textarea, select, radio and checkbox; a multiple select is joined with `,`

smootify-search.name: `query`
smootify-search.requiredNote: without it nothing searches; (2.0) the only text field gets this name whatever its Webflow Name

smootify-search-page.name: every `input[type="text"]` (any name)
smootify-search-page.does: renamed `q`, prefilled from `?q=`; the first filled one is the query

filter-search.name: every input but the submit (any name)
filter-search.does: renamed `query`; the first one sets the search & discovery query

sort-select.does: reads no name of yours: Smootify names the field `sort`

sort-radio.does: reads no name of yours: Smootify names the field `sort`

sort-dropdown.does: reads no name of yours: Smootify names the field `sort`
